The '''PU-36 modulator chip''' was a type of chip that was used in [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight engines]].

==History==
During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Xirossk]] stole a PU-36 chip from a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was used by the [[Heroes of Cularin]]. The chip was stolen after they landed on [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] to refuel. Without the chip, the engines and the ship's [[Power core/Legends|power core]] could not work, so the heroes set out in pursuit of Xirossk. The Trandoshan eventually returned the chip to the heroes and they refitted it to their ship.
